title: Oppo A7 Pro Max: Largest Battery Ever in an Oppo Phone
description: Oppo's A7 Pro Max has been officially confirmed, featuring the company's largest battery ever.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Oppo has officially confirmed the A7 Pro Max, a new smartphone model that comes with its largest battery ever, as reported by GSMArena.com.

sections.heading: Battery Capacity
paragraphs: According to 91Mobiles, the Oppo A7 Pro Max is teased with a massive 10,000mAh battery, which is expected to be a significant selling point for the device.

sections.heading: Processor
paragraphs: Notebookcheck mentions that the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 processor from Qualcomm has been spotted on Geekbench, running on the Oppo A7 Pro Max.

faq.q: What is special about the Oppo A7 Pro Max?
faq.a: The Oppo A7 Pro Max features Oppo's largest battery ever, with a capacity of 10,000mAh.

faq.q: Which processor is used in the Oppo A7 Pro Max?
faq.a: The Oppo A7 Pro Max is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 processor.
